case: SQLite COALESCE expression over a STRICT ANY column
contract: COALESCE(value, fallback-text) over mixed INTEGER, SQL NULL and TEXT storage returns exact INTEGER/TEXT/TEXT values.
SQLite typeof() independently confirms each result storage class.
Computed column metadata remains SQLx fallback NULL rather than claiming declared ANY.
Ordinary and bound query paths return the same exact values and metadata.

focused_integration.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-sqlite --test integration computed_coalesce_over_strict_any_keeps_fallback_metadata_and_storage_classes -- --exact

sqlite_integration_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-sqlite --test integration

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-sqlite --all-targets -- -D warnings
